Maria: FYI I opened a small docs PR to standardize the streaming + pagination snippets across Python/TS/Go — link in PR thread: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912
Sam: skimmed — mostly looks fine. noticed the Python example still uses the old sync iterator API (we moved to `.stream()` last quarter).
Kevin: which file exactly? I can patch both the snippet and the unit test that validates snippet output.
Maria: docs/reference/sdk/streaming.md — the 'Streaming with pagination' section. Also we need a brief retry example showing exponential backoff with jitter. Keep it tiny.
Andrew: Heads up CI: the docs link checker failed on /examples/python/paginate.md (404). Might be a broken cross-link from the new TS example.
ci-bot: Preview build: https://deploys.redwood.dev/preview/4871 — results: 12 warnings, 1 error (link not found: /examples/python/paginate.md).
docs-bot: Suggestion: add a one-line note about preserving cursor state when using streaming+pagination to avoid double-consumption.
Sam: For TS example, we should swap from the older `streamResponses()` helper to the unified `client.responses.stream()` pattern. Minimal change.
Kevin: I'll open a follow-up PR with three commits: 1) py snippet update, 2) ts snippet update, 3) fix broken link and update include path. Assigning to @Sam and @Maria for review.
Maria: assigning. @Sam can you take the TS/Go review, @Maria will do the Python bit (I'll check the wording).
Sam: Yep. I'll aim to review by EOD PST.
Kevin: Pushed commit for Python. Snippet (inline):
```
from redwood import Redwood

client = Redwood()

# streaming + pagination: use stream() and preserve cursor
for page in client.responses.paginate(model="rw-large", page_size=3):
    for chunk in client.responses.stream(page.cursor):
        print(chunk.text)
```
Kevin: Also added a tiny retry example using tenacity style backoff:
```
from tenacity import retry, wait_exponential_jitter

@retry(wait=wait_exponential_jitter(min=0.5, max=10))
def call_with_retries(prompt):
    return client.responses.create(model="rw-large", input=prompt)
```
Andrew: Thanks — that should satisfy the QA snippet tests. I updated the failing link to point to /examples/python/pagination-quickstart.md in the PR.
Sam: LGTM for TS change, left one nit about variable naming.
Maria: Great. Once CI passes on the preview I'll merge and backport a tiny changelog entry.
Kevin: CI report: preview build is green and link-check passed. :tada:
Maria: Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll add a short note in the migration guide about the API surface changes for stream/paginate.
